title: Valuables Floater Underwriting Guide: Schedulable Classes and Value Limits
content:
Which item classes a Larkspur Valuables Floater will schedule, and how much value it will take on one item and on the whole schedule, is fixed by the tier.

## Classes each tier schedules

| Item class | Classic | Select | Preferred | Prestige | Collector | Private Client |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Jewelry | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Watches | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Fine art | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Silverware | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Furs | no | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Cameras and optics | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Musical instruments | no | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Collectibles, stamps and coins | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Wine | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |

The Valuables Floater Classic schedules four classes (jewelry, watches, silverware, cameras). The Valuables Floater Select schedules six (jewelry, watches, silverware, furs, cameras, musical instruments). The Preferred, Prestige, Collector and Private Client tiers schedule all nine classes.

## Value limits (USD)

| Tier | Largest scheduled value for one item | Largest total scheduled value |
|---|---|---|
| Valuables Floater Classic | 25000 | 50000 |
| Valuables Floater Select | 50000 | 100000 |
| Valuables Floater Preferred | 100000 | 250000 |
| Valuables Floater Prestige | 150000 | 500000 |
| Valuables Floater Collector | 250000 | 1000000 |
| Valuables Floater Private Client | 1000000 | 5000000 |

## Points of judgement

- The single-item limit is measured against one item's scheduled value; the schedule limit is measured against the total scheduled value of all items currently on the floater's schedule.
- Hypothetical: a Valuables Floater Select with a schedule total of 92000 USD. A further item of 8000 USD brings the total to exactly 100000 USD, which is within the Select schedule limit; an item of 8100 USD would take the total to 100100 USD, which is not.
- Hypothetical: a painting cannot be scheduled on a Valuables Floater Classic or Select, whatever its value, because fine art is not a class those tiers schedule.
